scope: Corollary 6.4 (Witnesses for residual lists) of the manuscript “Translative covering densities of order n log n” (preprints/Translative-covering-densities-of-order-n-log-n-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 092 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2944d4b3135b4d79), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix A0 > 0. There are constants A, C∗, H > 0 such that, for all sufficiently large n, the following holds. Let R ≥ 1, and let (xαi)mα i=1, α ∈ A, be any finite nonempty family of deterministic lists satisfying 1 ≤ mα ≤ n2 , r− − 3η ≤ |xαi| ≤ b + 3η. Define Cαi = {u ∈ Sn−1 : |u · xαi| > 1 + 3η}, sαi = − log min{µ(Cαi), 1/2}, and suppose mα + P i sαi ≤ A0R. For each list there is a nonempty block partition and measurable slots EαS ⊆ T i∈S Cαi, chosen independently of Π, with positive intensities at most 1/2. Their activities and diagrams satisfy e−AR ≤ να ≤ 1, Dαα ≤ ν2 αeC∗R . (6.12) For distinct α, β, if all cross-residual angles exceed H p log n/n, then Dαβ ≤ n−3 νανβ. (6.13) If all those angles exceed 4 √ ε, then Dαβ = 0. A positive injection count for a list implies that every cap in that list is hit by Π.
